meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: 它会安装并初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault、配好网关,把 .env 里的 API 密钥迁移进保险库并删掉原密钥行,然后重新构建代码、重启服务并检查是否生效。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入后,或首次设置 OneCLI 时运行。若发现 .env 凭据或原生凭据代理,它会先问你是保留还是切换。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,把我 .env 里的凭据迁进去
say.note: 会先做环境检查再开始安装

say.text: OneCLI 装好了吗?帮我看看凭据配置
重装 OneCLI 并重新注册凭据
say.note: 走重配置流程,覆盖原有设置

howto.what_en: Installs and initializes OneCLI Agent Vault, configures the gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into the vault and removes the raw key lines, then rebuilds, restarts the service, and verifies.
howto.when_en: Run after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup. If .env credentials or a native credential proxy are found, it asks to keep or switch first.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and move my .env credentials into the vault
Is OneCLI set up? Check my credential configuration
say_en.note: Runs onecli version and secrets list

say_en.text: Reinstall OneCLI and re-register my credentials
say_en.note: Runs the reconfigure path, replacing old setup
